 Kevin O'Connell can't keep masking Vikings' quarterback chaos forever 
 By Allison Koehler | Nov 8, 2026, 8:00 AM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Minnesota Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell | Todd Rosenberg/GettyImages Kevin O'Connell is keeping the Minnesota Vikings winning through another quarterback change, but the offense is paying for every reset. The coach, long celebrated for his  quarterback whisperer reputation,  has become awfully good at making Plan B work. Building something sustainable is proving harder than keeping the Vikings competitive.
--> Kevin O'Connell is keeping the Minnesota Vikings winning through another quarterback change, but the offense is paying for every reset. The coach, long celebrated for his  quarterback whisperer reputation,  has become awfully good at making Plan B work. Building something sustainable is proving harder than keeping the Vikings competitive.
 Carson Wentz will start Monday against Buffalo while Kyler Murray sits with a hamstring strain. According to the Associated Press quarterback tally , that makes 17 injury- or performance-driven quarterback switches across 52 Vikings games since Kirk Cousins tore his Achilles in October 2023, including in-game changes. Somehow, Minnesota is 6-1.
--> Carson Wentz will start Monday against Buffalo while Kyler Murray sits with a hamstring strain. According to the Associated Press quarterback tally , that makes 17 injury- or performance-driven quarterback switches across 52 Vikings games since Kirk Cousins tore his Achilles in October 2023, including in-game changes. Somehow, Minnesota is 6-1.
 That record deserves respect, but it also conceals a problem. Minnesota is 29th in total offense at 279.4 yards per game and 27th in scoring at 20 points. Brian Flores' defense is allowing roughly 13 points per game. The defense has helped keep Minnesota winning, but the offense isn't holding up its end of the bargain.
--> That record deserves respect, but it also conceals a problem. Minnesota is 29th in total offense at 279.4 yards per game and 27th in scoring at 20 points. Brian Flores' defense is allowing roughly 13 points per game. The defense has helped keep Minnesota winning, but the offense isn't holding up its end of the bargain.
 Minnesota Vikings' quarterback changes are draining offensive continuity
--> Minnesota Vikings' quarterback changes are draining offensive continuity
 Murray and Wentz don't threaten defenses in the same ways. Murray's movement opens designed-run and option possibilities, forcing defenders to account for a quarterback who can keep the ball. Wentz is more reliant on getting the protection and timing right from the pocket. Those aren't interchangeable weekly game plans.
--> Murray and Wentz don't threaten defenses in the same ways. Murray's movement opens designed-run and option possibilities, forcing defenders to account for a quarterback who can keep the ball. Wentz is more reliant on getting the protection and timing right from the pocket. Those aren't interchangeable weekly game plans.
 Every switch also changes the preparation equation. First-team repetitions are finite, especially when the starter is hurt. O'Connell must prepare a replacement for Buffalo while keeping the larger offense moving forward. Minnesota hasn't disclosed how those repetitions are divided, but every quarterback change forces O'Connell to rethink how that time is spent.

 Justin Jefferson feels the practical consequences. He caught five passes for 33 yards in the loss at Detroit, another chapter in his growing frustration with inconsistent production. Route adjustments and anticipation throws depend on shared timing. T.J. Hockenson and the offensive line also have to adapt to different release points, reads, and cadences.

Route adjustments and anticipation throws depend on shared timing. T.J. Hockenson and the offensive line also have to adapt to different release points, reads, and cadences.
 Kevin O'Connell faces a bigger challenge than winning with Carson Wentz
--> Kevin O'Connell faces a bigger challenge than winning with Carson Wentz
 For all the offensive concerns, O'Connell has still managed to get results. Wentz threw three touchdown passes after replacing Murray in the opener, then helped beat Chicago in miserable weather. Sam Darnold's 14-win season in 2024 showed what this staff can produce when one quarterback gets an extended runway. This isn't a coach helpless without his preferred starter.

Sam Darnold's 14-win season in 2024 showed what this staff can produce when one quarterback gets an extended runway. This isn't a coach helpless without his preferred starter.
 Minnesota's earlier offensive warning signs predated Murray's latest injury, though. The concern isn't merely whether Wentz can steal another win. It's whether this offense can develop enough precision to score consistently when Flores can't dictate the game.
--> Minnesota's earlier offensive warning signs predated Murray's latest injury, though. The concern isn't merely whether Wentz can steal another win. It's whether this offense can develop enough precision to score consistently when Flores can't dictate the game.
 Buffalo's top-ranked scoring offense provides that test Monday. A week later, Minnesota visits Green Bay, where Murray could return if his hamstring recovers. Another change on a short turnaround would force O'Connell to decide how much of his offense can travel from one quarterback to the next without asking Jefferson to start building chemistry all over again.
